endings.name: Green in the Archive
endings.summary: Pulse reached 100 in the escape. The Toxin State took the stair, the security team and the archive door, in a form it has not used before and will not use again. He wakes in the archive, small in a wide red frame, and reconstructs it from the tents the Observers set out for him; they carried him back and will not stand near him yet. He lights the lamp in a fortress already stained.
endings.cost: Self 25 lower before the Fall begins, and the Observers have seen what he is.

endings.name: The Cage Alone
endings.summary: He took the stair alone and sealed the inner door behind him, and the security team went through the cells instead of after him. He comes back months later to a fortress with every cell open and every tank dry. He claims it alone; the amber lamp lights an empty room built for a family.

endings.name: The Spec Sheet
endings.summary: He tore the printout off the terminal: SUBJECT RCC53-Δ1 ("AEGIS") — BOND INTEGRITY 94.6%. He escapes with the Observers and claims the fortress, but on his return the printer room has been stripped to its bolts and the terminal shows one still: his own face at the housing, logged.
endings.cost: He knows "Aegis"; security knows his face.

endings.name: Fully Dr. Tox
endings.summary: As written: he read the spec sheet and left it on the screen, escaped with the Observers, returned and claimed the fortress. "Alexander is fully established as Dr. Tox — armored, armed, based in Snakehead." (bible Part VI, Dr. Tox, Story: Origin). The last image is the first signature image: shirtless in the bunker medical bay, the lead-shielded syringe, jaw clenched, eyes shut.
